verdict.rationale: Amplitude offers a documented MCP server and AI feature that lets users ask plain-language growth questions grounded in behavioral data, plus REST/Dashboard APIs to pull chart/query data programmatically, directly supporting agent-driven Q&A. However, this is an Amplitude-hosted analytics model rather than warehouse-native SQL access, and no independent evidence confirms real-world reliability of the MCP/AI answers, with community feedback questioning data accuracy generally.
